🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Giant Brown Butter Espresso Chocolate Lava Cake Makes 1 x 6” lava cake (perfect for two spoons) Ingredients:      •    100g unsalted butter     •    120g 54% dark chocolate, chopped     •    20g strong espresso or very strong coffee, hot     •    5g freshly ground coffee     •    2 medium eggs     •    2 egg yolks     •    120g caster sugar     •    100g self-raising flour     •    1 tsp vanilla extract     •    Pinch of flaky sea salt     •    Cocoa powder, for dusting the tin Method: 1.     Preheat the oven to 160°C (fan). This batter comes together quickly, so you want the oven ready. 2.    Place the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until it melts, foams, and the milk solids turn golden brown and smell nutty. Remove from the heat immediately. 3.    Add the chopped dark chocolate, hot coffee, ground coffee, vanilla, and flaky salt to the hot browned butter. Stir until the chocolate is fully melted and smooth. Set aside to cool slightly. 4.    In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, egg yolks, and caster sugar until pale and slightly thickened. This helps create structure while keeping the centre molten. 5.    Stir the flour into the chocolate mixture until just combined. Gently fold the egg mixture into the chocolate in two additions, keeping as much air as possible. 6.    Grease a 6” round tin and dust generously with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess. 7.    Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake for 18 minutes. The edges should be set, with a soft, slightly wobbly centre. 8.    Rest for 2–3 minutes before serving. Spoon straight from the tin or carefully turn out.

🍫 GÂTEAU VOLCAN  Dimensions du moule ➡️Env. 22 × 18 cm  Ingrédients ➤ Gâteau 	•	3 œufs 	•	170 g d’huile neutre 	•	100g de sucre 	•	75 g de cacao non sucré 	•	240 g d’eau chaude 	•	180 g de farine 	•	15 g de levure chimique 	•	1 c. café rase de bicarbonate ➤ Sirop chocolat 	•	480 g de lait 	•	120 g de cacao 	•	30 g de beurre ➤ Ganache 	•	200 g de chocolat (noir, lait ou mix) 	•	200 g de crème liquide Étapes : Préchauffe ton four à 180°C chaleur tournante. Dans un grand bol, fouette ensemble les œufs, le sucre, l’huile, le cacao et l’eau chaude jusqu’à obtenir une pâte lisse. Ajoute la farine, la levure et le bicarbonate et mélange juste assez pour que la pâte soit homogène. Verse dans un moule beurré ou huilé d’environ 22 × 18 cm et enfourne 25 minutes, en surveillant dès 20 minutes : le centre doit rester tremblotant. Pendant la cuisson, prépare le sirop chocolat en chauffant le lait, le sucre, le cacao et le beurre jusqu’aux premiers frémissements puis coupe le feu. Dès que le gâteau sort du four, verse tout le sirop dessus et laisse absorber 10 à 15 minutes. Fais chauffer la crème, verse-la sur le chocolat, laisse fondre puis mélange et nappe le dessus. Sers tiède, à la cuillère, texture volcan garantie 😍🍫

This molten lava cake turns out perfect both in air fryer and oven 🤎 Crisp edges, rich & molten inside 🍫 Ingredients: 2 servings (divide by half for 1 serving) Chocolate 80 g (~½ cup) (chopped) Butter 50 g (~3½ tbsp) Sugar 35 g (~3tbsp) (adjust sweetness according to taste) 2 small whole eggs (room temp)( or use 1 large egg+egg yolk) Flour 16 g (2 tbsp) Cocoa powder 8g (1 tbsp) A pinch of salt  ½ tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp instant coffee (optional) Directions:  Melt chocolate and butter by Microwaving in short bursts (or double boiler) until smooth. Add coffee and mix. Whisk eggs and sugar until slightly pale and combined (no need to overbeat). Pour melted chocolate into egg mixture, mix gently. Add flour, cocoa powder and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Grease small oven-safe cups or mugs and lightly dust with cocoa powder. Pour the batter evenly into both cups. Air Fryer Instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C for 3–5 minutes. Bake for 9–10 minutes for a fully molten center, or 11–12 minutes for a slightly more set but still gooey center. Oven Instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C for 5–7 minutes. Bake at 180°C for 14–15 minutes, or add 2–3 extra minutes for a more set and slightly gooey center. Let it rest 1–2 mins before unmolding. Serve with ice cream 🍨🤎 Enjoy!  . . . #moltenlava #moltenlavacake #chocolate #chcolatecake #reels  . . . These were out of this world 🤤 Soulistic Lava Cakes Ingredients 	•	60g unsalted butter 	•	85g dark chocolate 	•	55g coconut sugar 	•	1 large egg 	•	1 large egg yolk (room temperature) 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract 	•	1 tbsp Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao 	•	2 tsp plain flour 	•	Pinch sea salt To serve (optional): 	•	Dusting of Soulistic  Method 1. Preheat your oven to 220°C (200°C fan-forced). Generously grease and lightly dust two 180ml ramekins (or three 120ml ramekins) with Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao 	 2. Melt the butter and chocolate together over low heat on stove consistently stirring between, until smooth. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut sugar, egg, egg yolk and vanilla until slightly fluffy (an electric hand mixer works best). 4. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture and stir until combined. 5. Gently fold through the Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao, flour and salt until just combined. 6. Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. 7. Bake for 10–11 minutes (for 180ml ramekins) or 7–8 minutes (for 120ml ramekins). The edges should be set while the centre remains slightly wobbly. 8. Let the cakes rest for 2–3 minutes, then carefully invert onto serving plates. 9. Serve immediately with a dusting of Soulistic and enjoy!
